{{Quote|The Imperial Star Destroyers ''Bombard'' and ''Crusader'' limped back to Ord Grovner Naval Base this week after dealing a death-blow to the arrogant and once-almighty Eyttyrmin Pirates of the Khuiumin system.|TriNebulon News|<ref name="GNN" />}}
The '''Ord Grovner Naval Base''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval]] facility located at [[Ord Grovner]]. The [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]] ''[[Bombard]]'' and [[Crusader (Victory-class)|''Crusader'']] returned to the base after [[Battle of Khuiumin|dealing]] with the [[Eyttyrmin Batiiv]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].
